definitions.explanation: needle-like ice crystals that form in soil when moisture in the ground freezes and pushes up through the surface

examples.english: When you step on frost pillars, they make a crunchy sound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|ひ}え{込|こ}んで→冷え込む：11727_hiekomu⟧{霜柱|しもばしら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It was so cold this morning that frost pillars had formed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{霜柱|しもばしら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だった。
examples.english: When I was a child, I liked stepping on frost pillars.

notes:
USAGE:
Columns of ice that grow up out of moist, bare soil on clear, cold nights, lifting a crust of earth with them. Crunching them underfoot on the way to school is a familiar winter memory in much of Japan.
